articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?

articles.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
articles.snippet: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.

articles.title: OpenAI Says It's Made Progress on a Second $1 Million Math Problem
articles.snippet: Days after its disputed Navier-Stokes claim, OpenAI says it's made "substantial progress" on another Millennium Prize math problem—and won't say which one yet.

articles.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
articles.snippet: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

articles.title: Meta May Have Found a Fix for Its 'Pervert Glasses'
articles.snippet: Meta is reportedly developing a version of its smart glasses without a camera, potentially addressing one of the biggest privacy objections to AI wearables.
